facts.text: Sensor-condition reproduction ratings distinguish what a model can represent from what has been demonstrated against measurements.
facts.quote: The ratings below separate what a model can represent from what has been shown against measurements.

facts.text: Much of the strong literature on reproducing conditions for sensors is based on on-road or laboratory evidence.

facts.text: A "good" sensor-condition reproduction rating does not establish that a model is safe to use without validating the particular sensor on the particular machine.
